title: 線形代数Ⅰ（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Linear Algebra I
courseType: Mathematics and Science ProgramMathematics and Science Courses
teachers:
WATANABE Shuji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) vector operations.
(2) matrix operations.
(3) solving linear systems using “row reduction.”
(4) representing linear transformations of a plane or a space.
advice:
This is a basic course in linear algebra. We will cover the following topics:

1. Vectors
1.1 Vectors and their operations
1.2 Dot products and cross products of vectors
1.3 The equation of a plane or a line
2. Matrices and linear maps
2.1 Matrices and their operations
2.2 Linear systems and row reduction
2.3 Linear maps and linear transformation

Classes include exercises and quizzes; a final examination will be given at the end of the semester.
Daily preparation and review are important. Students are required to complete the designated tasks.
Students should prepare reports and study research topics in a planned manner, and strictly avoid plagiarism.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.
books:
Textbook: Linear Algebra I (KIT Math and Science Academic Foundations Programs)
Reference book: A First Course in Linear Algebra (Open Textbook Library)[Lyryx]
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics, especially trigonometric functions.

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of vectors and be able to properly perform vector operations.
Understand the concept of matrices and be able to properly perform matrix operations.
Be able to find solutions to linear systems by using row reduction.
Understand the concept of a linear transforms and be able to represent them in matrix form.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for mathematics.
Understand the contents of the course and be able to complete the required tasks by the announced deadlines.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Properly perform vector operations and find the equations of planes or lines.
(2) Properly perform matrix operations.
(3) Solve 'complex' linear systems using row reduction.
(4) Understand the concept of linear maps and properly determine representation matrices.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Properly perform vector operations.
(2) Properly perform matrix operations.
(3) Solve 'fundamental' linear systems using row reduction.
(4) Find representation matrices of linear transformations in a plane.
